{{TOC|side}}
Textures available for use with [[setFlagTexture]]. See [[:Category:Command Group: Flags|Command Group: Flags]] for all flag commands.


== File Location ==

{{ofp}} comes with an addon called {{hl|Flags.pbo}} which contains all the flags of the world. You can find it in the addons folder.


== Flag Textures ==

* "\flags\usa.jpg"
* "\flags\ussr.jpg"
* "\flags\fia.jpg"


== Flag Texture Files ==

* "usa_vlajka.pac" (US flag)
* "rus_vlajka.pac" (Soviet Union flag)
* "guba_vlajka.pac" (Guba's private flag)
